_comment: The evaluation of the synthetic project read as recorded (specs/SPEC.md sec. 2.6 and blocks 33-38; D-159, D-162, D-163, D-164 of the decision log): D-162's validation of the recorded path on davinci -- the new path run on the synthetic project, then compared with the synthetic evaluation of synth_eval.json (ev_rec_validate.py). A file of its own: synth.json and synth_eval.json are not touched. Read by hpc/pipeline/evaluation/ev_rec_config.py: every key is required, there are no defaults in the code, and a key starting with '_' documents the key after it and is ignored. Values marked [Claude's] are logistics, not the user's decisions.
_out_root: Absolute. samples/ (block 35), metrics/ (block 36), figures/ (block 37), jobs/ (block 38) and VALIDATION.json under it; beside the synthetic evaluation's out_root, never inside it (wave C's contract).
_seed: The synthetic evaluation's (synth_eval.json): with it the new path draws from the same seeds as blocks 19 and 20 (sec. 2.6, the validation).
_n_post: The synthetic evaluation's (D-163 (4): 1,000; 200 from each of the five members).
_batch_rows: The synthetic evaluation's: the same batches through a member as block 19's. [Claude's]
_oracle_tol: The synthetic evaluation's (nats; 2e-3, 2026-11-12): each rebuilt member must reproduce its recorded per-row NLL within it; it changes no output.
_as_recorded: true: the synthetic project read as recorded (D-162); the cohorts' theta* never reach the code under test.
_sim_draw_rows_per_donor: null: draws on every row of D_sim, so the rows and the seeds are blocks 19's (sec. 2.6, the validation).
_edge_eps: The edge width eps of (R1): the logistic function at -5, the flow's spline bound (D-163 (4)).
_gate: The gate (D-161, D-163 (4), D-164): the networks' fractions (reference, rank, null, check), the caps, the smallest null set, the rows of a network per set, the kernel's bandwidth factors, alpha_gate.
_level: The synthetic evaluation's: the level of the bands and intervals.
_formats: The synthetic evaluation's (Q-E6: PNG and PDF).
_ncpus: The synthetic evaluation's: worker processes when a command is run by hand; a job passes its own cores (jobs below). [Claude's]
_validate_against: The out_root of synth_eval.json: the synthetic evaluation the validation compares with (ev_rec_validate.py --old).
_jobs: Block 38: the PBS queue (intel, D-137) and each kind's resources -- sample (one per ensemble, ev_rec_sample.py) and report (one: metrics, figures, report) as the synthetic evaluation's (Q-R5); validate (one, ev_rec_validate.py: it reads two trees of JSON and NPZ files). [Claude's]
